payload.exit_check: One engine verify green over all of it: board /open honors viewer-alive; TTL 6h; remedies callable; restore --staged only; patch keeps dollar sequences literal; fileSearch returns multiple hits per file, ranked mode orders multi-term queries, fuzzy mode matches subsequence filenames; se_note mints a ledger note in one call and the projection carries it.
